title: [Soup´s] desaturated crops
description: Desaturates the crop stems A LOT
body:
A small texture-pack which _heavily desaturates crop stems, wheat, and other related items. This texture-pack _only_ affects crop stems, excluding pumpkins, melons, berries, and glowberries. 

As of the moment, this is **VANILLA ONLY** ´^`"
